messages.학생이 스스로 사용한 방법을 말하게 하고 새 과제에서도 같은 방법을 써: Have students share the methods they used and try to use the same methods on new assignments.Check for two weeks to see if the same method remains when the assignments become more difficult.
messages.핵심 단서를 찾고 놓친 뒤 과제로 돌아오는 행동이 안정적으로 관찰된 가상: This is a hypothetical example in which the behavior of finding key clues, missing them, and then returning to the task was reliably observed.
messages.확인할 행동 — 과제 시작까지 걸린 시간, 전략 변경과 제출 전 점검 여: Actions to check — Record how long it took you to start the assignment, whether you changed your strategy, and whether you reviewed it before submitting it.
messages.확인할 행동 — 부분 정보를 전체 의미로 연결하는지, 시각 자료 뒤 설명: Actions to check — Note whether pieces of information are connected to the overall meaning and whether explanation accuracy varies after the visual.
messages.확인할 행동 — 지시 재현, 단계 누락, 순서 카드 사용 뒤 독립 수행의: Behaviors to check — Record changes in independent performance after reproducing instructions, missing steps, or using sequence cards.
messages.확인할 행동 — 집중 지속 시간보다 과제로 돌아온 횟수, 정확도와 도움: Behaviors to check — Record the number of times you return to the task, along with accuracy and use of assistance, rather than attention span.
messages.활동 전에 찾을 단서 하나에 밑줄을 긋게 하고 10분 뒤 1분 점검을 둡: Before the activity, have them underline one clue to look for and then do a one-minute check after 10 minutes.Instead of publicly pointing out when you miss something, use the desk markers you promised, along with recording your attention span and the number of times you return on your own.
